name: "icapital.biz Berhad"
recent: iCapital.biz Berhad 近期主要动态包括：大股东 City of London Investment Management 多次申报持股变动；基金经理相关人士在公开市场买卖股份；公司发布截至2026年5月31日的季度财报，营收同比增长44.8%；此外，公司涉及一项重大诉讼，上诉许可听证会已延期。
notable: 大股东 City of London Investment Management 在11月多次申报持股变动。
基金经理相关人士在公开市场买卖公司股份。
公司发布截至2026年5月31日的季度财报，营收同比增长44.8%。
risks: 公司涉及重大诉讼，相关法律程序仍在进行中。
大股东 City of London Investment Management 近期多次申报持股变动，需关注其持股变化。
earnings: 截至2026年5月31日的季度，公司营收为4,282,000令吉，同比增长44.8%，环比增长79.7%；净利润为1,194,000令吉，净利率27.9%，较上一期的-11.6%转正。

recent_en: iCapital.biz Berhad's recent developments include: multiple changes in substantial shareholder interest by City of London Investment Management; dealings in listed securities by a designated person of the fund manager; the release of quarterly results for the period ended 31 May 2026 with revenue up 44.8% year-on-year; and a material litigation matter where the leave-to-appeal hearing has been vacated.
notable_en: Substantial shareholder City of London Investment Management reported multiple changes in its shareholding in November.
A designated person of the fund manager dealt in the company's shares in the open market.
The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 31 May 2026, with revenue up 44.8% year-on-year.
risks_en: The company is involved in material litigation, and the legal proceedings are ongoing.
Substantial shareholder City of London Investment Management has reported multiple changes in its shareholding recently; its shareholding changes warrant attention.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 May 2026, revenue was MYR4,282,000, up 44.8% year-on-year and 79.7% quarter-on-quarter; net income was MYR1,194,000 with a net margin of 27.9%, turning positive from -11.6% in the previous period.
